rationale: With only one 5-minute candle available (session just opened at 09:31:40), there is virtually no intraday structure to trade against — no EMA context, no ATR, and no multi-candle pattern to define a meaningful entry thesis in either direction. Waiting for more price discovery and structure to develop is the correct mechanical response here.
